findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The Home On Deck row loads 20 series at a time and keeps paging for more; there is no 50-series cap.

findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: Home rows are carousels with no collapse control and nothing stores a collapsed state.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library screen has no Random button; the header only has the name, actions menu and series count.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal is a daily scheduled cleanup job, and only for series that are Completed or Cancelled and 100% read; finishing a series does not remove it immediately.

findings.fsdQuote: Manga series open on the Volumes tab by default.
findings.note: For manga (and other non-comic, non-book libraries) the default tab is Storyline, not Volumes.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can keep a private note on a series that only they can see.
findings.note: No series note feature exists in the series screen or its models.
Series screen also has an Annotations tab, an Activity (reading history) tab, and a Kavita+ scrobbling toggle, none mentioned.

findings.fsdQuote: A chapter's screen shows its release date, writers, cover artists, genres and tags
findings.note: Release date is shown only in Comic and Comic (Flexible) libraries, where it replaces the cover artists slot; other library types show cover artists and no release date.

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: The image reader brightness slider has a minimum of 10%, not 0%.

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: The image reader has no slideshow or auto-advance mode.
Layout list has a fourth option, Double (No Cover), and the settings also hold auto-close menu, swipe to paginate, emulate comic book, page offset and width override.

findings.fsdQuote: Font size can be set from 50% to 200%.
findings.note: Book reader font size range is 50% to 300%.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: No text-to-speech or read-aloud feature exists in the book reader.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: Collection actions are edit, download, delete, promote/unpromote and mark read/unread; there is no CSV export.

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears when the list has more than 10 items.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No public sharing link exists for reading lists; the detail route requires the auth guard.
In reorder mode there is a Remove Read button that clears already-read items from a non-promoted list.
A Genres browse screen lists every genre with series and issue counts and opens All Series filtered to the genre; the FSD covers People and Tags only.
An Annotations browse screen lists annotations with a filter panel, bulk actions and an Export button; not described.
Person page has an actions menu (such as merge and edit) and shows web links beside the name.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: The Account page has no two-factor option and no authenticator support exists in the code.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The server requires a minimum of 6 characters.
Account page lets an OpenID Connect-linked user unlink the OIDC account.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The threshold is 100 MB (the tooltip also says 100).

Preferences also hold Blur Unread Summaries, Collapse Series Relationships, On Deck last-progress days, On Deck last-chapter-add days, a book highlight colour bar, Share Profile, Include Unknowns, and OPDS options (progress indicator, continue-from).

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: There is no Save button; changes are saved automatically about 300 ms after each valid edit.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: No maintenance mode switch exists on the General page or in the server settings.
General page also has a Logging Level selector.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form has only email, libraries, roles and age restriction; no expiry date field.
Non-pending user rows also have a change-password button.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The add-library form starts with Manage Collections off.
Libraries page has row checkboxes and a bulk action menu (scan, refresh metadata, generate colorscape, delete, copy settings).
